title: Sparkly heart
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="heartGlow" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b9d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e0245e"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sparkGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fffbe6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffe066"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Main heart shape -->
  <path d="M50 82 
           C30 68, 14 54, 14 38 
           C14 26, 24 18, 34 18 
           C40 18, 46 22, 50 30 
           C54 22, 60 18, 66 18 
           C76 18, 86 26, 86 38 
           C86 54, 70 68, 50 82 Z" 
        fill="url(#heartGlow)" 
        stroke="#ff9ec4" 
        stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- Heart highlight/shine -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="32" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#ffb3d1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="30" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffd6e8" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Large sparkle top-left -->
  <g transform="translate(22, 18)">
    <path d="M0 -7 L2 -2 L7 0 L2 2 L0 7 L-2 2 L-7 0 L-2 -2 Z" 
          fill="url(#sparkGlow)" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Large sparkle top-right -->
  <g transform="translate(78, 22)">
    <path d="M0 -6 L1.8 -1.8 L6 0 L1.8 1.8 L0 6 L-1.8 1.8 L-6 0 L-1.8 -1.8 Z" 
          fill="#ffe066" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Medium sparkle bottom-left -->
  <g transform="translate(18, 62)">
    <path d="M0 -5 L1.5 -1.5 L5 0 L1.5 1.5 L0 5 L-1.5 1.5 L-5 0 L-1.5 -1.5 Z" 
          fill="#ffd633" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Medium sparkle bottom-right -->
  <g transform="translate(82, 58)">
    <path d="M0 -5 L1.5 -1.5 L5 0 L1.5 1.5 L0 5 L-1.5 1.5 L-5 0 L-1.5 -1.5 Z" 
          fill="#ffd633" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small sparkle top-center -->
  <g transform="translate(56, 10)">
    <path d="M0 -3.5 L1 -1 L3.5 0 L1 1 L0 3.5 L-1 1 L-3.5 0 L-1 -1 Z" 
          fill="#fffbe6" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="0.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small sparkle left -->
  <g transform="translate(8, 40)">
    <path d="M0 -3 L0.8 -0.8 L3 0 L0.8 0.8 L0 3 L-0.8 0.8 L-3 0 L-0.8 -0.8 Z" 
          fill="#fff3b0" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small sparkle right -->
  <g transform="translate(90, 44)">
    <path d="M0 -3 L0.8 -0.8 L3 0 L0.8 0.8 L0 3 L-0.8 0.8 L-3 0 L-0.8 -0.8 Z" 
          fill="#fff3b0" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tiny sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="12" r="1.5" fill="#fffbe6"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="14" r="1.2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="28" r="1" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="34" r="1.2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="76" r="1" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="1.3" fill="#fffbe6"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="88" r="1" fill="#ffe066"/>

  <!-- Extra tiny twinkles -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="8" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="16" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="10" cy="54" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="66" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
</svg>
